# PhAST Brand Assets

Use only these three public marks:

| File | Use |
|---|---|
| `phast-banner.png` | Wide placements such as README headers and docs hero banners. |
| `phast-icon.png` | Favicon, small navigation icon, and compact UI placements. |
| `phast-logo.png` | Circular/display-picture placements such as organization cards, profile-style blocks, and centered hero marks. |

Do not add extra logo variants without replacing one of these roles.
